Attachment

  • CURIE: gmeow:Attachment
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Attachment
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/email
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

A non-inline body part presented as an attached file. An attachment may also be a gmeow:Document or gmeow:MediaObject (the two are not disjoint), and its text extraction or summary is a derived object linked by gmeow:wasDerivedFrom.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:BodyPart

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Attachment as a specialized kind of gmeow:BodyPart. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:BodyPart
